observations: Standard maps to hybrid high, Advanced to hybrid xhigh.
high passes precomputed high_vlm_blocks to VLM; xhigh inference does not pass that blocks_list.
image_analysis forwarded only for xhigh; xhigh normalizes VLM block classes, splits titles with layout support and supplements missing image containers.
Same checkpoint identities do not mean the same layout/recognition execution path. These code facts do not prove the cause of any particular CER or region error.
